title: 1 Enoch 76 — The twelve gates of the four winds at the ends of the earth

translation.sourceText: 1 Enoch Astronomical Book (Book of the Luminaries / Sefer ha-Mazzalot) — per-verse layered-witness reconstruction (Aramaic DSS 4Q208-4Q211, OLDEST surviving Enoch material late 3rd c. BCE, primary where preserved; Ge'ez Charles 1912 PD + Knibb 1978 fallback). No Greek witness — Akhmim Panopolitanus covers chs 1-32 only.

paragraphs.text: ובאפי ארעא חזית עשרה ותרין תרעין פתיחין לכל רוחיא דמנהון נפקין רוחיא ונשבין על ארעא
paragraphs.translit: u-ba-ʾappē ʾarʿāʾ ḥăzēt ʿaśrāh u-tĕrēn tarʿīn pětīḥīn lě-kol rūḥayyāʾ dī minhōn nāpĕqīn rūḥayyāʾ wě-nāšbīn ʿal ʾarʿāʾ

i18n.en: And at the ends of the earth I saw twelve gates open for all the winds, from which the winds come forth and blow upon the earth.

notes.official:
**The twelve gates and four winds cosmography — Aramaic-PRIMARY witness (4Q210 frag 1 col. ii).** This verse opens 1 En 76's systematic cosmographic-meteorology framework: twelve gates of heaven (three at each of the four cardinal directions) through which the cosmic-winds blow. The framework is one of the most-elaborate cosmographic-systematizations of the Second-Temple-period apocalyptic-literature.

The framework extends the simpler 1 En 33-36 four-corners-and-gates cosmography (which has gates at the four cardinal-directions without the three-fold sub-division per direction) into a more-systematic 12-gate framework. The framework is paralleled in Zech 6:1-8 (the four chariots + four winds), Dan 7:2 (the four winds of heaven stirring the sea), Rev 7:1 (the four angels at the four corners holding back the four winds), and Sura 41:9-12 (the seven heavens + the cosmic-organization of the cosmos).

See central entry `twelve-gates-four-winds-cosmography-1-enoch-76-cross-corpus`.

paragraphs.text: תלתא אנון במדנח שמיא ותלתא במערב ותלתא בימינא דשמיא ותלתא בשמאלא
paragraphs.translit: tělātāʾ ʾinnōn bě-madnāḥ šĕmayyāʾ ū-tělātāʾ bě-maʿărāb ū-tělātāʾ bě-yāminā dī-šĕmayyāʾ ū-tělātāʾ bi-śĕmālāʾ

i18n.en: Three of them are in the east of heaven, and three in the west, and three on the right of heaven, and three on the left.

notes.official: **Aramaic-PRIMARY witness — the 3+3+3+3 cardinal distribution.** The Aramaic uses *yamin* / *semal* ('right / left' = south / north when oriented to the rising sun) — the standard Semitic cardinal-orientation convention where one orients the body to face east (the rising sun). The three-gates-per-cardinal-direction distribution (3 × 4 = 12 total) is the systematic framework that distinguishes 1 En 76 from the earlier four-corners cosmography of 1 En 33-36 (where each cardinal-direction has only one gate). Cross-corpus to Rev 21:13 (the New Jerusalem with three gates per cardinal direction: 3 × 4 = 12 gates total) — the Rev 21 framework directly parallels the 1 En 76 cosmographic systematization.

paragraphs.text: ወቀዳሚሁ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ ዘጎ፡ ሰሜን፡ ዘይትለዐል፡ ወዘይከውን፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ መንፈስ፡ ቍር፡ ወአስሐትዮት፡ ወድካም፡ ወአሕማም፡ ወሐዘን፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-qadāmihu ʾəmənnehomu zago samēn zayətlaʿʿal wa-zayəkawwən lāʿlēhu manfas qwər wa-ʾasḥātyot wa-dəkām wa-ʾaḥmām wa-ḥazan

i18n.en: And the first among them, on the side of the north, which is raised up — there is upon it a wind of cold and hoarfrost, fatigue, sickness, and sorrow.

paragraphs.text: ወእምነ፡ መንገል፡ ካዕብቱ፡ ዘበማእክለ፡ ይወፅእ፡ ዘፍሥሓ፡ ወዘጥዕና፡ ወዘጠል፡ ወዘዝናም፡ ወዘስብእ፡ ወዘበረከት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəmənna mangal kāʿbətu zabamāʾəkla yəwaḍḍəʾ zafəśśəḥā wa-zaṭəʿnā wa-zaṭall wa-zazənām wa-zasəbʾ wa-zabarakat

i18n.en: And from the second gate in the middle there comes forth joy, health, dew, rain, prosperity, and blessing.

paragraphs.text: ወእምነ፡ ካልዕ፡ መንገል፡ ይወፅኡ፡ ንዋማት፡ ወዕርፍት፡ ወምሕረት፡ ወሕይወት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəmənna kāləʿ mangal yəwaḍḍəʾu nəwāmāt wa-ʿərft wa-məḥrat wa-ḥəywat

i18n.en: And from the other gate there come forth sleep, rest, mercy, and life.

paragraphs.text: ወእምነ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ሰማይ፡ ዘሠለስቱ፡ አናቅጽ፡ ቀዳማይ፡ ዘይትለዐል፡ ጾታሁ፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ እምኔሁ፡ ይወፅእ፡ ጠል፡ ወዝናም፡ ወአንበጣ፡ ወድካም፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəmənna məśrāq samāy zaśallastu ʾanāqəḍ qadāmāyə zayətlaʿʿal ṣotahu mangala samēn ʾəmənnehu yəwaḍḍəʾ ṭall wa-zənām wa-ʾanbaṭā wa-dəkām

i18n.en: And from the three gates of the east of heaven: the first, whose side is raised toward the north — from it come forth dew and rain and locusts and fatigue.

paragraphs.text: ወእምነ፡ መንገል፡ ካዕብ፡ ዘበማእክል፡ ዘይወፅእ፡ ብርሃን፡ ወዝናም፡ ወጠል፡ ወሐይል፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəmənna mangal kāʿb zabamāʾəkəl zayəwaḍḍəʾ bərhān wa-zənām wa-ṭall wa-ḥayl

i18n.en: And from the second gate in the middle there come forth light and rain and dew and strength.

paragraphs.text: ወእምነ፡ መንገል፡ ካልዕ፡ ይወፅእ፡ መንፈስ፡ ሞቅ፡ ወድርቅ፡ ወሕማም፡ ወማዕታት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəmənna mangal kāləʿ yəwaḍḍəʾ manfas moq wa-dərq wa-ḥəmām wa-māʿtāt

i18n.en: And from the other gate there comes forth a wind of heat and drought and sickness and deaths.

paragraphs.text: ወእምነ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ አናቅጽ፡ ዘበየማን፡ ሰማይ፡ ቀዳማይ፡ ዘጎ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ይወፅእ፡ መንፈስ፡ ሞቅ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəmənna śallastu ʾanāqəḍ zaba-yamān samāy qadāmāyə zago məśrāq yəwaḍḍəʾ manfas moq

i18n.en: And from the three gates on the right of heaven: the first, on the side of the east — from it comes forth a wind of heat.

paragraphs.text: ወእምነ፡ መንገል፡ ካዕብ፡ ዘጎ፡ ይወፅእ፡ ጠል፡ ወዝናም፡ ወአንበጣ፡ ወድካም፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəmənna mangal kāʿb zago yəwaḍḍəʾ ṭall wa-zənām wa-ʾanbaṭā wa-dəkām

i18n.en: And from the second gate, on its side, there come forth dew and rain and locusts and fatigue.

paragraphs.text: ወእምነ፡ መንገል፡ ሣልስ፡ ይወፅእ፡ ዘጎ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ጠል፡ ወዝናም፡ ወአንበጣ፡ ወድካም፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəmənna mangal śāləs yəwaḍḍəʾ zago məʿrāb ṭall wa-zənām wa-ʾanbaṭā wa-dəkām

i18n.en: And from the third gate, on the side of the west, there come forth dew and rain and locusts and fatigue.

paragraphs.text: ወእምነ፡ ምዕራብ፡ ሰማይ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ አናቅጽ፡ ቀዳማይ፡ ዘጎ፡ ሰሜን፡ እምኔሁ፡ ይወፅእ፡ ጠል፡ ወዝናም፡ ወጾታ፡ ወማዕታት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəmənna məʿrāb samāy śallastu ʾanāqəḍ qadāmāyə zago samēn ʾəmənnehu yəwaḍḍəʾ ṭall wa-zənām wa-ṣotā wa-māʿtāt

i18n.en: And from the west of heaven, three gates: the first, on the side of the north — from it come forth dew and rain and hoarfrost and deaths.

paragraphs.text: ወእምነ፡ መንገል፡ ካዕብ፡ ዘበማእክል፡ ይወፅእ፡ ዝናም፡ ወጠል፡ ወሕይወት፡ ወበረከት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəmənna mangal kāʿb zabamāʾəkəl yəwaḍḍəʾ zənām wa-ṭall wa-ḥəywat wa-barakat

i18n.en: And from the second gate in the middle there come forth rain and dew and life and blessing.

paragraphs.text: ወእምነ፡ መንገል፡ ሣልስ፡ ዘጎ፡ ጾታ፡ ይወፅእ፡ መንፈስ፡ ድሙት፡ ወቍር፡ ወድካም፡ ወሐዘን፡ ወዘንቱ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡ ለነፋሳት፡ ዘይነፍሑ፡ ዘይኬልሉ፡ እምነ፡ አርባዕቱ፡ ማእዘን፡ ለሰማይ፡ ኮኑ፡ ኆለቆሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəmənna mangal śāləs zago ṣotā yəwaḍḍəʾ manfas dəmut wa-qwər wa-dəkām wa-ḥazan wa-zantu ḫolaqomu la-nafāsāt zayənafāḥu zayəkēlalu ʾəmənna ʾarbāʿtu māʾəzan la-samāy konu ḫolaqomu

i18n.en: And from the third gate, on the side of the south, there comes forth a wind of silence and cold and fatigue and sorrow. And this is the reckoning of the winds that blow and circle from the four corners of heaven — such is their reckoning.
